mapper.select: SELECT * FROM safety_checklist_item WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_checklist_item (template_id, category, item_text, severity, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{category}, #{itemText}, COALESCE(#{severity}, 'NORMAL'), COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE safety_checklist_item SET category = COALESCE(#{category}, category), item_text = COALESCE(#{itemText}, item_text), severity = COALESCE(#{severity}, severity), sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, sort_order), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE safety_checklist_item SET status = 'INACTIVE' WHERE id = #{id}
